description: This file constitutes a script that performs static code analysis on TypeScript/JavaScript source files to detect channel-agnostic boundary violations, such as improper importations, configuration path references, channel comparisons, and hardcoded channel or system markings. It includes utility functions for parsing source files, applying specific rules, and reporting violations.

methods.name: findChannelAgnosticBoundaryViolations
methods.description: Analyzes a source file content to find violations related to channel-agnostic boundaries such as module imports, config path references, comparisons, and assignments.

methods.name: findChannelCoreReverseDependencyViolations
methods.description: Specialized analysis to find violations in reverse dependency of channel core.

methods.name: findAcpUserFacingChannelNameViolations
methods.description: Detects user-facing text that directly references specific channel names, which may violate channel independence.

methods.name: findSystemMarkLiteralViolations
methods.description: Detects hardcoded system mark literals (e.g., '⚙️') in source files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Orchestrates the overall process: collects files, runs scans, and reports violations.
